description:
A fantastic app to provide scroll lyrics for Spotify and other apps


1. [Add] Lyricify Lyrics Stage, a new fullscreen lyrics view.
2. [Add] New animations and background for Apple Music Lyrics, closer to the original.
3. [Add] Dynamic Lyrics Island spectrum and customizable side content.
4. [Add] Word shine preset selection for Dynamic Lyrics Island.
5. [Add] Smooth corners and hover hiding options for Dynamic Lyrics Island.
6. [Add] Track info only mode for Dynamic Lyrics Island and Desktop Lyrics.
7. [Fix] Improve Traditional Chinese conversion with regional preferences.
8. [Add] Ctrl-click word-by-word seeking in main lyrics.
9. [Add] Independent left and right margins for main lyrics.
10. [Fix] Dynamic Lyrics Island context menu in Byland mode.
11. [Fix] Notify icon context menu closing.
12. [Fix] Font access restrictions in Apple Music Lyrics.
13. [Fix] Reload shortcut restrictions in Apple Music Lyrics.
14. [Fix] Crashes in duet view under certain conditions.
15. [Fix] QQ Music import link recognition.
16. [Fix] Musixmatch token caching.
17. [Fix] Restore full exception logging during login.
